note: Lane Command Center is the platform; a program is one major initiative running on it. Core objects - Task, Decision, Risk, Question, Assumption, Milestone, Rule - are generic and carry a program tag. Nothing is named MoveTask.

statuses.active: Running. Its rules are live and its tasks compete for attention.
statuses.paused: Deliberately dormant. Rules stay recorded but do not fire.
statuses.complete: Finished. Program-scoped rules retire; decisions and evidence are kept as history.
statuses.abandoned: Stopped without completing. Same retirement behavior as complete, different meaning.
